regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Life insurance cover during the entire Policy Term (Sum Assured on Death)
Wealth Creation: Guaranteed Maturity Benefit (GMB) plus accrued Guaranteed Additions at end of Policy Term
Assured Income / Second Income: regular guaranteed income (Base Income plus accrued Income Boosters) during the Income Period
Return of Premium (ROP) benefit of 50% to 300% of Total Premiums Paid (Assured/Second Income variants, where chosen)
Assured Income variant: on death during PT, a guaranteed income stream plus ROP-on-death is initiated
Death benefit not less than Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid or surrender value, whichever higher
Tax-free / guaranteed positioning is conditional (see guardrails)
riders_available: Bajaj Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life New Waiver of Premium Rider
Bajaj Life Care Plus Rider Non-Linked

eligibility.min_premium: Rs 30,000 (minimum premium when combining variants); Rs 1 lakh threshold for High Premium Mark-up
eligibility.policy_term: Wealth Creation offers Maturity Age <100 or =100; full PT/PPT grid not captured from this parse
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Limited / Regular options (exact range not captured from this parse)
eligibility.note: Age/term values shown are the POS-channel maxima explicitly stated in the brochure (Max entry 55, Max maturity 65, Max PT 20, Max Sum Assured on Death Rs 25 lacs for POS). The full non-POS eligibility table was not recovered from the parse — verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (electronic or otherwise).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or surrender value as on date of death; provided the policy is in force.
key_terms.loan_note: Policy loan available once surrender value is acquired, up to 80% of surrender value. Current loan interest 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly (benchmarked to G-Sec).
key_terms.tax_note: Brochure headlines 'TAX-FREE' returns referencing Section 11 (read with Schedule II, Sr.No.2) of the Income Tax Act — strictly conditional and subject to prevailing tax laws; consult a tax advisor.

claims_marketing_must_support: Maturity / GMB and Guaranteed Additions apply to the Wealth Creation variant; income payouts (Base Income + Income Boosters) apply to Assured Income and Second Income variants — every benefit claim must be variant-qualified.
All benefits are guaranteed ONLY provided the policy is in-force and all due premiums have been paid — this condition must accompany any 'all benefits guaranteed' claim.
ROP benefit is a chosen multiple (50%-300%) of Total Premiums Paid; under Second Income, if ROP is not chosen there is NO maturity benefit.
Guaranteed Addition / Income Booster accrual requires at least two full policy years' premiums paid.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'bonus' language — this is a non-participating plan; the upside is guaranteed additions/income, not declared bonuses.

Do NOT present 'TAX-FREE' returns as unconditional — the brochure's tax-free claim is footnoted to specific Income Tax Act provisions and is subject to eligibility and prevailing tax laws; the conditional footnote must be carried.
Do NOT position as a market-linked / investment product — it is non-linked, non-participating; returns are fixed guaranteed amounts, not market growth.
Do NOT imply guaranteed income figures without stating they depend on variant, PT, PPT, deferment/income period and Sum Assured multiple.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan'
The 'Conditions Apply' / 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveats accompanying any guaranteed-income or tax-free headline
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions
